messages:
alex_support: Heads-up — customer cust-721 (Carl) reports embeddings suddenly halved in width after we flipped a frozen variant for embed-giant-v2. Search relevance tanked. They started seeing vectors of length 768 instead of 1536.

carl_customer: Repro steps: POST /v1/embeddings with model=embed-giant-v2 (we pin via variant header). Response vector length = 768. Example payload and returned length below.
```json
{
  "input": "turn on the kitchen lights"
}
// response: { embeddings: [[0.001, 0.002, ..., 0.123]] } // length = 768
```

mia_eng: Can you paste the exact model header you used? pinned variant name? Any feature flags?

carl_customer: We set X-Redwood-Variant: frozen-2026-03-15 and left batching on. No other flags.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolled frozen-2026-03-15 for embed-giant-v2 to production in us-west-2 @ 2026-03-15T10:02:11Z

dylan_ml: Possible root cause: alias for frozen-2026-03-15 got mapped to a quantized/halfwidth variant (compatibility alias) that uses a 768 projection. Batching + prefix-cache could have mixed cached KV shapes leading to silent truncation.

mia_eng: +1 to that. If the routing layer accepts an alias that points to a different embedding head, we need to validate vector schema at ingress. Did they get any warnings in the response headers (e.g., X-Embed-Width)?

carl_customer: No header warnings. Just suddenly shorter vectors.

mia_eng: Please run this quick repro to get the trace id (we need request-id):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Variant: frozen-2026-03-15" -d '{"input": "test vector length check"}' -D - | head -n 50
```
Capture the X-Request-Id and X-Embed-Width headers.

carl_customer: Got it, sending the headers now: X-Request-Id: rq_83b2f9, no X-Embed-Width header present.

dylan_ml: rq_83b2f9 shows routing -> variant_fallback: compat-embed-gq8q, which is a 768-dim proj. Looks like the alias resolution changed during rollout. There's a mismatch between the variant alias registry and the pinned alias mapping.

mia_eng: Temporary mitigation: set header X-Redwood-Force-Variant: embed-giant-v2@v1536 or use model parameter model=embed-giant-v2:v1536 (explicit version) — that bypasses alias lookup. Also recommend turning off client-side batching for a quick check.

carl_customer: Forced variant worked — vectors are back to 1536. Turning off batching didn't change it. Thanks.

jina_sre: Created incident INC-2026-045 to track. Attaching impact: 1 big customer, search relevance down, no backend errors, silent schema change.

mia_eng: Action items: 1) Add schema validation at ingress (emit warning header + 4xx on mismatch for embeddings). 2) Fix alias registry race during frozen variant flips. 3) Add alert when vector width deviates for a given model/variant. 4) Postmortem and customer update.

dylan_ml: I'll prepare a hotfix to emit X-Embed-Width in all embedding responses and fail-fast on shape mismatch for pinned variants. Will also add a smoke test that checks vector length after any frozen-variant rollout.

alex_support: Noted. I'll update the customer: rolled back alias mapping for frozen-2026-03-15 and asked them to use forced-version until hotfix. Will include timeline and SR link.

carl_customer: Appreciate the fast turnaround. Please confirm when the fixed behavior is live so we can re-enable pinned alias.

jina_sre: Will notify when deploys complete and add to the incident.

mia_eng: ETA for hotfix deploy: ~3 hours. Rolling patch to registry + ingress validation.

alex_support: Closing loop with customer and setting reminder to follow up in 24h for validation. :thumbsup:
